sections.heading: Apify buyer question and thesis
sections.body:
CI/CD and automation; proxy / web data network; developer AI assistance; enterprise security and SSO. Free · free · CI/CD and automation | Starter | Scale. Python, Nodejs. Teams that want ready-made or custom Actors rather than raw proxy ops; Developers who need compute + storage + proxy in one platform; Projects that benefit from Apify Store scrapers. Apify is a web-scraping and automation platform built around Actors (ready-made or custom scrapers), compute units, storage, and Apify Proxy. Free includes list price prepaid usage. That catalogue mix is the Apify implementation filter — not a generic it-development lecture.

Buyer question: does Starter gating CI/CD and automation change the Apify decision before seats scale?

Decision thesis: unlike a generic it-development shortlist, Apify is worth it if Teams that want ready-made or custom Actors rather than raw proxy ops outweighs Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle — trade-off accepted before seats scale.

Best for: Teams that want ready-made or custom Actors rather than raw proxy ops; Developers who need compute + storage + proxy in one platform; Projects that benefit from Apify Store scrapers (Teams that want ready-made or custom Actors rather than raw proxy ops).

Poor fit when: Buyers who only need residential GB without an Actor runtime; Hosting panel or ITSM purchases; Enterprises that insist on ISO 27001 proxy-first vendors only. Avoid if Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle would block go-live.

sections.heading: Apify limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle; Actor Store and proxy GB costs can exceed the plan sticker quickly; Not an enterprise proxy-network-first buy like Bright Data / Oxylabs because it forces process changes or add-ons around Apify when CI/CD and automation is the job.

Pricing interpretation: stay on Free until CI/CD and automation is mandatory; plan jumps to Starter only after that hinge is proven.

Plan trade-off: you gain CI/CD and automation at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Free · free · CI/CD and automation | Starter | Scale.

Alternative context: unlike Bright Data, Apify is preferable when Teams that want ready-made or custom Actors rather than raw proxy ops because CI/CD and automation plus CI/CD and automation match; prefer Bright Data when Buyers who only need residential GB without an Actor runtime because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Apify
sections.body:
Scenario: for CI/CD and automation teams, recommend Apify when Teams that want ready-made or custom Actors rather than raw proxy ops; recommend an alternative path when Buyers who only need residential GB without an Actor runtime because Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for CI/CD and automation plus a freeze window if Python are in the cutover path.

Integrations in research: Python, Nodejs.

Final call: proceed with Apify when CI/CD and automation plus CI/CD and automation outweigh Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle; walk when Buyers who only need residential GB without an Actor runtime because workarounds will eat the Starter spend.
